#### PR description:

type of scintillator tile is confused between granularity (fine/coarse) and type of scintillator (cast/mould). For geometry operations, the distinction between fine/coarse is more important, and it is changed accordingly in decode/encode operations.

#### PR validation:

Tested using the existing scripts.
